finish_summary: Discrepancies found: bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity = 20 but spec requires 10%. Cart.total adds shipping fee incorrectly – implementation charges shipping on all non‑free carts and does not subtract bulk discount. Shipping_fee logic only frees when subtotal >=1000, contradicting test expecting shipping added regardless of subtotal. Overall the module’s behavior diverges from specification in these areas.
